name: Schlage Encode Plus (US)

radios.note: Schlage describes it as a deadbolt with built-in Wi-Fi (2.4 GHz). Retailer listings also mention Bluetooth, and Allegion's setup guide has you turn on your phone's Bluetooth to pair, but no Schlage page seen lists Bluetooth as a lock radio.

matter.note: Allegion's knowledge base says the Encode Plus is not Matter-enabled and does not currently support Matter.

apple_home.note: Added to Apple Home through HomeKit, including Apple Home Key (tap iPhone or Apple Watch). Home Key needs iPhone XS or later with iOS 15+, or Apple Watch Series 4+ with watchOS 8+.

google_home.note: Through the Schlage Home app and Google Assistant: lock, unlock and check status. No hub needed.

alexa.note: Alexa skill via the Schlage Home app. Voice unlock must be switched on in the Alexa app.

smartthings.note: Schlage's pages seen list Alexa, Google and Apple but not SmartThings, and the lock has no Matter. Only forum posts say SmartThings is incompatible, so we do not mark it 'no'.

home_assistant.note: Official Schlage integration, which uses Schlage's cloud API for Wi-Fi locks and lists the Encode Plus as working.

hubRequired.note: Schlage says Encode products need no hub or adapter; the lock has built-in Wi-Fi.

localControl.note: Home Assistant control goes through Schlage's cloud; no source confirms what works with the internet down. Schlage notes voice control stops during a Wi-Fi outage.

lockFit.note: Sold as a complete smart deadbolt (BE499WB) with Century or Camelot trim, in several finishes.

keypad.note: Touchscreen keypad on the lock with unique access codes for each person.

power.note: Schlage's BE499WB product page lists four AA alkaline batteries (included) and up to six months of battery life in typical use.

summary: The Schlage Encode Plus is a Wi-Fi deadbolt with a touchscreen keypad that you can also open by tapping an iPhone or Apple Watch (Apple Home Key). It works with Apple Home, Google Home and Alexa without a hub, and Home Assistant has an official Schlage integration that runs through Schlage's cloud. It is not a Matter device, and SmartThings support is not listed by Schlage.
caveats: Not Matter-certified; Allegion says it does not currently support Matter.
The official Home Assistant integration is cloud-based, so updates depend on Schlage's servers.
Voice control through Alexa and Google stops working during a home Wi-Fi outage.
Remote control through Apple Home needs a home hub such as an Apple TV or HomePod.
